# DataForSEO LLM Mentions Target Metrics API

Mention counts and AI search volume for a domain or keyword in AI answers, with breakdowns by platform, location and source.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/target_metrics/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/target_metrics/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"target": [{"domain": "nike.com"}], "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `target` | Array of up to 10 entities, each with one `domain` or one `keyword` (optional `search_filter`, `search_scope`, `match_type`). |
| `location_code` | Location code; default 2840 (United States). |
| `language_code` | Language code; default "en". |
| `platform` | Optional: "google" (AI Overviews) or "chat_gpt". Omit for both. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/target_metrics/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.101 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
